eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Jefferson, TX; at 8:08 AM on AUG 15, 2023 Effective until 8:08 AM AUG 16, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Continued Lack of Rain and Excessive Heat has Elevated Mandatory Water Restrictions to a Level 3. The City of Beaumont is requiring all customers to conserve and discontinue water use for non-essential purposes, including landscaping, pools + more. Read More >> https://beaumonttexas.gov
